qualityShelfPolicy: The learner-facing Short Stories shelf is capped at 50 curated works, balanced across six categories. The 100-record Aozora source archive remains intact for Saved/Continue compatibility.
extendedPassagePolicy: When a curated Story is opened online, Sakura requests a longer verbatim passage from that record's allowlisted Aozora Bunko source. Successful passages are cached on the learner's device for rereading. If the source request is unavailable or fails validation, the bundled original excerpt remains the fallback.
sourceYearPolicy: Public-domain works display their actual first-publication year when known, otherwise a source-edition year. Historical literature is never presented as current fiction.

rights.policy: Only works identified in Sakura's source archive as copyright-expired/public-domain are used in this shelf.
rights.fullTextPolicy: The repository bundles a short original fallback excerpt. Longer displayed passages are fetched from the linked Aozora source on demand and cached locally; Sakura does not bundle a separate full-text corpus.

qualityPolicy.storyText: Story text is verbatim public-domain Japanese from the linked Aozora work; Sakura does not generate or rewrite the fiction.
qualityPolicy.difficulty: Sakura approximate study difficulty only; native works are not JLPT-graded.
qualityPolicy.orthography: Original-source orthography is preserved as far as the Aozora HTML text representation allows.
qualityPolicy.selection: The visible v9 Quality Shelf contains 50 balanced selections. Source records outside the shelf remain available for Saved/Continue compatibility.
qualityPolicy.fallback: Every Story keeps its bundled source excerpt so a source-reader outage never prevents the Story from opening.
